title: Authorization Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the authorization policy for an API or feature. Enforces: default-deny posture, no wildcard allows in production, no unauthenticated access to admin operations, multi-tenant data isolation, scoped M2M actors, and admin role separation.

error_codes.AZ001: authz-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: defaultEffect, roles[], endpoints[]
error_codes.AZ002: No default-deny rule found — authorization policy must fail closed
error_codes.AZ003: Wildcard (*) allow rule found in production policy — explicit resource grants only
error_codes.AZ004: Admin operation accessible without authentication — all admin endpoints require auth
error_codes.AZ005: Cross-tenant data access possible — all queries must be scoped to tenantId
error_codes.AZ006: M2M service actor has broad scope — service accounts must be scoped to minimum required permissions
error_codes.AZ007: Admin role inherits from regular user roles — admin must be a separate, isolated role
